description: This file defines the CustomerOption class, representing a customer attribute option in the system. It extends ShopEntity and includes properties such as type, name, default value, and available values, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Represents a customer attribute option with properties for type, name, default value, and available values. Extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the customer option.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the customer option.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the customer option.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the customer option.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default customer option value.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default customer option value.

methods.name: getAvailableValues
methods.description: Returns the list of available customer option values.

methods.name: setAvailableValues
methods.description: Sets the list of available customer option values.
